notes.lag: lag 0 = newest input row, one row = 0.2 s, uniform weight = 1/30
notes.entropy_norm: per-window entropy / ln 30, mean over windows (1 = uniform)
notes.tv_from_mean: mean total-variation distance between a window's attention and the mean map
notes.comb_ratio_1s: per-window spectra: power at a 5-row period / mean power of the two neighbouring frequencies (phase free, 1 = no comb)
notes.phase_lift_rsc<c>: attention / mean map at the same (step, lag), averaged over rows whose rows-since-update value of the 1 Hz report target is c (1 = no preference); the target is the first of jitter, loss, rtt whose classes 0..4 each hold 10-30 % of the rows
notes.fresh_comb_contrast: windows whose newest row is a fresh 1 Hz report: mean weight at lags 0,5,..,25 / mean weight at the other lags. Not meaningful where the oldest rows are an attention sink (5G, OneWeb): the sink at lags 26-29 falls in the 'other lags'
notes.rsc_round_err_<t>: max |count - round(count)| of the denormalised rows-since-update input; large where z-clipping merged counts, such targets are excluded from the phase tables (rsc_class_targets lists the rest)
notes.spike_lift: attention on the input RTT spike row / calm windows' mean attention on the same (step, lag), ratio of sums over spike windows
notes.event_lift: same for the newest handover / satellite-change row (baseline: windows without an event)
notes.event_pre_lift: attention mass on rows older than the event / baseline mass on those lags
notes.event_post_lift: attention mass on rows newer than the event / baseline mass on those lags
notes.grad_<out>: share of |d RTT mean forecast / d input| by lag, summed over features, total derivative (S2S through its fed-back forecasts, which its decoder detaches only as a training device); out = h1, h15 or sum over steps; '_change' = forecast minus the anchored last value (DS2S only); '_raw' = base input features only, i.e. without the engineered trailing statistics (DS2S only, S2S has only base features)
notes.grad_<out>_eng_feature_share: share of |gradient| (all lags) on the engineered features (trailing means up to 60 s, session mean, rows since update, row_dt), DS2S only
notes.abl_*: test forecasts recomputed with every window's attention replaced by the mean map of VALIDATION windows (valmap) or by uniform weights; RTT mean-forecast MAE / RMSE over all steps (and MAE at step 15) on the analysed test windows; ratio = ablated / own attention (1 = the attention pattern does not matter); shift = mean |ablated - own forecast| in ms; move = mean |own forecast - persistence| in ms; tv_valmap_testmap = total-variation distance between the validation and test mean maps
notes.max_abs_diff_vs_saved: CPU recomputation vs saved GPU test forecasts (ms, % for loss), both models
